description: SOC-thermal voltage model: V = OCV(SOC) - I*R(T), with Arrhenius resistance and capacity correction

cell.name: Panasonic NCR18650B (NCA)
cell.source: Tremblay & Dessaint (2009), IEEE Trans. Veh. Technol.; Panasonic NCR18650B datasheet

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5
ocv_coefficients.source: Fitted to NCA OCV data from Tremblay & Dessaint (2009); Panasonic NCR18650B

E_a.note: Activation energy for internal resistance (NCA more temp-sensitive)
E_a.source: Ecker et al. (2015); Schuster et al. (2015), J. Power Sources, 286, 580-589

alpha_c.source: Schmalstieg et al. (2014), J. Power Sources, 257, 325-334

dOCV_dT.source: Viswanathan et al. (2010), J. Electrochem. Soc., 157(10), A1040-A1046
